26517-mary-jane-s-city-home.title: Mary Jane'S City Home
26517-mary-jane-s-city-home.creator: Clara Ingram Judson
26517-mary-jane-s-city-home.description: A book by Clara Ingram Judson. The late afternoon sunshine sent its slanting, golden rays through the car windows on to the map that Mary Jane and her sister Alice had spread out on the table between the seats of the Pullman in which they were riding.

arxiv-1905-06797.title: Cutting plane oracles for non-smooth trust-regions
arxiv-1905-06797.creator: Dominikus Noll
arxiv-1905-06797.description: Abstract . We prove global convergence of a bundle trust region algorithm for non-smooth non-convex optimization, where cutting planes are generated by oracles respecting four basic rules. The benefit is that convergence theory applies to a large variety of methods encountered in practice.

arxiv-2101-03643.title: Primary Decomposition with Differential Operators
arxiv-2101-03643.creator: Yairon Cid-Ruiz, Bernd Sturmfels
arxiv-2101-03643.description: Abstract . We introduce differential primary decompositions for ideals in a commutative ring. Ideal membership is characterized by differential conditions. The minimal number of conditions needed is the arithmetic multiplicity. Minimal differential primary decompositions are unique up to change of bases.

arxiv-2105-13105.title: Drazin invertibility of linear operators on quaternionic Banach spaces
arxiv-2105-13105.creator: El Hassan Benabdi and Mohamed Barraa
arxiv-2105-13105.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by El Hassan Benabdi and Mohamed Barraa. Let A A be a right linear operator on a two-sided quaternionic Banach space X X . The paper studies the Drazin inverse for right linear operators on a quaternionic Banach space.

arxiv-2105-14391.title: Data-driven 6D Pose Tracking by Calibrating Image Residuals in Synthetic Domains
arxiv-2105-14391.creator: Bowen Wen Rutgers University bw344@scarletmail.rutgers.edu, Chaitanya Mitash Amazon cmitash@amazon.com, Kostas Bekris Rutgers University kostas.bekris@cs.rutgers.edu
arxiv-2105-14391.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Bowen Wen Rutgers University bw344@scarletmail.rutgers.edu, Chaitanya Mitash Amazon cmitash@amazon.com, Kostas Bekris Rutgers University kostas.bekris@cs.rutgers.edu. Tracking the 6D pose of objects in video sequences is important for robot manipulation. This work presents s ​ e ​ ( 3 ) se(3) -TrackNet, a data-driven optimization approach for long-term, 6D pose tracking. It aims to identify the optimal relative pose given the current RGB-D observation and a synthetic image conditioned on the previous best estimate and the object’s model.

arxiv-2110-09580.title: Flexible Accuracy for Differential Privacy
arxiv-2110-09580.creator: Aman Bansal, Rahul Chunduru, Deepesh Data, Manoj Prabhakaran
arxiv-2110-09580.description: Abstract Differential Privacy (DP) has become a gold standard in privacy-preserving data analysis. While it provides one of the most rigorous notions of privacy, there are many settings where its applicability is limited. Our main contribution is in augmenting differential privacy with Flexible Accuracy , which allows small distortions in the input (e.g.

arxiv-2112-09788.title: Heavy-tailed denoising score matching
arxiv-2112-09788.creator: Jacob Deasy, Nikola Simidjievski, Pietro Liò
arxiv-2112-09788.description: Abstract Score-based model research in the last few years has produced state of the art generative models by employing Gaussian denoising score-matching (DSM). However, the Gaussian noise assumption has several high-dimensional limitations, motivating a more concrete route toward even higher dimension PDF estimation in future.

arxiv-2202-12854.title: Data-driven discovery of active nematic hydrodynamics
arxiv-2202-12854.creator: Chaitanya Joshi, Sattvic Ray, Linnea M. Lemma, Minu Varghese, Graham Sharp, Zvonimir Dogic, Aparna Baskaran, Michael F. Hagan
arxiv-2202-12854.description: Abstract Two-dimensional active nematics are often modeled using phenomenological continuum theories that describe the dynamics of the nematic director and fluid velocity through partial differential equations (PDEs). While these models provide a statistically accurate description of the experiments, the identification of the relevant terms in the PDEs and their parameters is usually indirect.

arxiv-2204-14234.title: Vietoris–Rips Complexes of Metric Spaces Near a Metric Graph
arxiv-2204-14234.creator: Sushovan Majhi
arxiv-2204-14234.description: Abstract . For a sufficiently small scale β > 0 \beta>0 , the Vietoris–Rips complex ℛ β ​ ( S ) \mathcal{R}_{\beta}(S) of a metric space S S with a small Gromov–Hausdorff distance to a closed Riemannian manifold M M has been already known to recover M M up to homotopy type.

arxiv-2309-03164.title: J-Guard: Journalism Guided Adversarially Robust Detection of AI-generated News
arxiv-2309-03164.creator: Tharindu Kumarage Amrita Bhattacharjee Djordje Padejski Kristy Roschke
arxiv-2309-03164.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tharindu Kumarage Amrita Bhattacharjee Djordje Padejski Kristy Roschke. The rapid proliferation of AI-generated text online is profoundly reshaping the information landscape. Among various types of AI-generated text, AI-generated news presents a significant threat as it can be a prominent source of misinformation online. While several recent efforts have focused on detecting AI-generated text in general, these methods require enhanced reliability, given concerns about their vulnerability to simple adversarial attacks.

arxiv-2309-11695.title: Active perception network for non-myopic online exploration and visual surface coverage
arxiv-2309-11695.creator: David Vutetakis, Jing Xiao
arxiv-2309-11695.description: Abstract This work addresses the problem of online exploration and visual sensor coverage of unknown environments. We introduce a novel perception roadmap we refer to as the Active Perception Network (APN) that serves as a hierarchical topological graph describing how to traverse and perceive an incrementally built spatial map of the environment.

arxiv-2405-11209.title: The IACOB project
arxiv-2405-11209.creator: S. Simón-Díaz, N. Britavskiy, N. Castro, G. Holgado, A. de Burgos
arxiv-2405-11209.description: Abstract Context. Observations have definitively strengthened the long-standing assertion that binaries are crucial in massive star evolution. While the percentage of spectroscopic binary systems among main-sequence O stars is well-studied, other phases of massive star evolution remain less explored. Aims.

arxiv-2502-20463.title: Personal Narratives Empower Politically Disinclined Individuals to Engage in Political Discussions
arxiv-2502-20463.creator: Tejasvi Chebrolu, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru, Ashwin Rajadesingan
arxiv-2502-20463.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tejasvi Chebrolu, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru, Ashwin Rajadesingan. Engaging in political discussions is crucial in democratic societies, yet many individuals remain politically disinclined due to various factors such as perceived knowledge gaps, conflict avoidance, or a sense of disconnection from the political system. In this paper, we explore the potential of personal narratives—short, first-person accounts emphasizing personal experiences—as a means to empower these individuals to participate in online political discussions.

arxiv-2504-00926.title: Combined Aerial Cooperative Tethered Carrying and Path Planning for Quadrotors in Confined Environments
arxiv-2504-00926.creator: Marios-Nektarios Stamatopoulos, Panagiotis Koustoumpardis, Achilleas Seisa, George Nikolakopoulos
arxiv-2504-00926.description: Abstract In this article, a novel combined aerial cooperative tethered carrying and path planning framework is introduced with a special focus on applications in confined environments. The proposed work is aiming towards solving the path planning problem for the formation of two quadrotors, while having a rope hanging below them and passing through or around obstacles.

arxiv-2602-16766.title: A Sample of Nearby Isolated Dwarf Galaxies: A First Look at the Mass Function of Field Dwarfs Journal: ApJ astropy ( 9 ; 7 ; 8 ) , photutils ( 24 ) , sep ( 11 ) , imfit ( 60 ) , SWarp ( 19 ) , Scamp ( 18 ) , SExtractor ( 17 ) , astrometry.net ( 114 )
arxiv-2602-16766.creator: Scott G. Carlsten, Jiaxuan Li (李嘉轩), Jenny E. Greene, Alex Drlica-Wagner, Shany Danieli
arxiv-2602-16766.description: Abstract We present the results of the Exploration of Local VolumE Survey - Field (ELVES-Field), a survey of the dwarf galaxies in the Local Volume (LV; D < 10 D<10 Mpc) over roughly 3,000 3,000 square degrees, focusing on the field dwarf population. Candidates are detected using a semi-automated algorithm tailored for low surface brightness dwarfs.

pmc-10572925.title: An Analysis of Optical Coherence Tomography Angiography (OCT-A) Perfusion Density Maps in Patients Treated for Retinal Vein Occlusion with Intravitreal Aflibercept
pmc-10572925.creator: Dorota Śpiewak, Katarzyna Witek, Łukasz Drzyzga, Ewa Mrukwa-Kominek, Isabel Pinilla
pmc-10572925.description: Aim: The primary goal of this study was to evaluate the reduction in non-perfusion area and improvement in blood flow as well as the reduction in retinal edema on optical coherence tomography angiography (OCT-A) in patients with retinal vein occlusion treated with 2 mg intravitreal injections of aflibercept.

pmc-10617301.title: Kids Mod PAH trial: A multicenter trial comparing mono‐ versus duo‐therapy for initial treatment of pediatric pulmonary hypertension
pmc-10617301.creator: Joseph M Collaco, Steven H Abman, Eric D Austin, Catherine M Avitabile, Angela Bates, Jeffrey R Fineman, Grace A Freire, Stephanie S Handler, Dunbar D Ivy, Usha S Krishnan, Mary P Mullen, Nidhy P Varghese, Delphine Yung, Melanie K Nies, Allen D Everett, Kanecia O Zimmerman, William Simmons, Hrishike
pmc-10617301.description: Pulmonary hypertension (PH) is a significant health problem that contributes to high morbidity and mortality in diverse cardiac, pulmonary, and systemic diseases in children. Evidence‐based advances in PH care have been challenged by a paucity of quality endpoints for assessing clinical course and the lack of robust clinical trial data to guide pharmacologic therapies in children.

pmc-11585773.title: Receptor Kinase Signaling of BRI1 and SIRK1 Is Tightly Balanced by Their Interactomes as Revealed From Domain-Swap Chimaera in AE-MS Approaches
pmc-11585773.creator: Lin Xi, Xuna Wu, Jiahui Wang, Zhaoxia Zhang, Mingjie He, Zeeshan Zeeshan, Thorsten Stefan, Waltraud X Schulze
pmc-11585773.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). At the plasma membrane, in response to biotic and abiotic cues, specific ligands initiate the formation of receptor kinase heterodimers, which regulate the activities of plasma membrane proteins and initiate signaling cascades to the nucleus. In this study, we utilized affinity enrichment mass spectrometry to investigate the stimulus-dependent interactomes of LRR receptor kinases in response to their respective ligands, with an emphasis on exploring structural influences and potential cross-talk events at the plasma membrane.

pmc-11603433.title: Association Between Cognitive Function and Emotion, Sleep, Frailty, and Nutrition in Hospitalized Patients
pmc-11603433.creator: Nan Wang, Qunying Zhang, Peng Li, Lilan Guo, Xiaoman Wu, Qiuyun Tu
pmc-11603433.description: BackgroundWith the rapid increase in China's aging population, cognitive impairment in the elderly has become a significant public health issue.AimsIn this study we performed a cross‐sectional analysis to comprehensively investigate the relationship between cognitive function and emotion, sleep, frailty, nutrition, and clinical variables in hospitalized geriatric patients according to age group and sex.

pmc-12473620.title: Hierarchical Sectorized ANN Model for DoA Estimation in Smart Textile Wearable Antenna Array Under Strong Noise Conditions
pmc-12473620.creator: Zoran Stanković, Olivera Pronić-Rančić, Nebojša Dončov
pmc-12473620.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). A novel hierarchical sectorized neural network module for a fast direction of arrival (DoA) estimation (HSNN-DoA) of the signal received by a textile wearable antenna array (TWAA) under strong noise conditions is presented. The developed DoA module accounts for variations in antenna element gain, inter-element spacing, and resonant frequencies under the conditions of textile crumpling caused by the motion of the TWAA wearer.

pmc-12658265.title: Postural stability reveals cognitive load of holding an intention in mind
pmc-12658265.creator: Maximilian Haas, Christian Chicherio, Matthias Kliegel, Delphine Fagot
pmc-12658265.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). It is well known that walking while talking may be challenging, but does merely keeping a future intention in mind (i.e., prospective memory, PM), even without execution, impose cognitive costs on postural stability? Reaction times and accuracy in a primary cognitive activity used so far may not fully capture these hidden costs, whereas center of pressure (COP) fluctuations offer a promising task-external indicator of cognitive load due to shared cognitive-postural resources.

pmc-13146914.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1255 HEALTH AND SOCIAL CARE COSTS OF RECURRENT STROKE: LONG-TERM FOLLOW-UP OF A POPULATION-BASED COHORT
pmc-13146914.creator: Ramon Luengo-Fernandez, Louise Silver, Peter Rothwell
pmc-13146914.description: Background and aimsImproved life-expectancy after TIA/stroke has increased the patient-years lived at risk of recurrent stroke. There are few reliable data on recurrence rates on current best medical treatment (BMT) or on the long-term impact on care costs. We aimed to quantify the long-term cost burden of recurrent stroke after an initial TIA or stroke.

pmc-13292442.title: Perceptions of caring behaviours among patients, nurses, nursing students: mixed methods systematic review
pmc-13292442.creator: Nafisa Bardaie, Janet Holt, Gretl A. McHugh
pmc-13292442.description: BackgroundThe foundation and core value of the nursing profession is caring. Worldwide, it is expected that nursing education will cultivate caring behavior amongst nurses to fulfill the health needs of a patient. Three earlier reviews related to caring behavior were identified. However, these reviews were conducted over ten years ago and other literature has since been published.

pmc-13391538.title: Stress and loneliness in marriage: does loneliness moderate the effects of daily stress on marital satisfaction?
pmc-13391538.creator: Nick Frye-Cox, Jeremy B. Yorgason
pmc-13391538.description: Although stress is widely recognized as a key predictor of marital satisfaction, less is known about how daily experiences of loneliness may shape this association. Loneliness, whether stable or fluctuating, may alter how spouses interpret and respond to daily stressors. Participants were 155 heterosexual married couples who completed daily surveys over seven consecutive days.

uslaw-usc-t10-s8215.title: 10 U.S.C. § 8215 — Citizenship of officers of vessels
uslaw-usc-t10-s8215.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s8215.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 825 (Administration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The officers of vessels of the United States shall in all cases by citizens of the United States.

uslaw-usc-t30-s188a.title: 30 U.S.C. § 188a — Surrender of leases
uslaw-usc-t30-s188a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t30-s188a.description: United States Code, Title 30 (Mineral Lands And Mining); Chapter 3A (Leases And Prospecting Permits); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Interior is authorized to accept the surrender of any lease issued pursuant to any of the provisions of this chapter, or any amendment thereof, where the surrender is filed in the Bureau of Land.
